decisions.text: slices by group, largest group first, each group's parts together in their given order, clockwise from 12 o'clock (07 §5.2): Sports Cars, Other Cars, Pickup Trucks, Other Trucks, Motorcycles
each slice its own colour, handed out in slice order (D-22 (a)): Sports Cars series-1, Other Cars series-1 tint, Pickup Trucks series-2, Other Trucks series-2 tint, Motorcycles series-3
each slice named outside it, its value under the name, formatted as one set (G7.27, D-51 (ii)): $37 million, $82 million, $21 million, $40 million, $20 million
no outlines: true gaps 1.0 pt wide between the slices (G7.26s: 0.7 % of the diameter)

source.shows: overlapping categories separated before they are sliced (Cars less Sports Cars is Other Cars): each group's parts together, the larger group first, its named part first, in the group's colour and a tint of it, so that the containment stays visible (R7-05, G0.14, D-24)
